Italian operations (Preatoni Nuda Proprietà and Preatoni Intermediazioni Immobiliari) faced a challenging market with subdued transaction volumes.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Group acquired an additional 10% stake in Preatoni Nuda Proprietà S.r.l. in September 2025, increasing its ownership to 77.5%, and recognized a full impairment loss of EUR 863 thousand on the associated goodwill due to revised profitability projections and financing dependencies.

candidate_sentences.text: These gains were partly offset by an EUR 863 thousand impairment of goodwill related to the Italian Preatoni Nuda Proprietà business, whose projections reflected delayed profitability and dependence on additional financing.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Group amended terms of its senior secured callable fixed-rate bonds (ISIN SE0013801172) in February 2025, partially repaid EUR 9.405 million in August 2025, reducing outstanding nominal amount to EUR 10.545 million, and managed bank loan repayments and new borrowings to maintain financing flexibility.
